senses.gloss:
(ऌ औ) औ मुचॢ r. 6th cl. (मुञ्चति-ते)
1 To be loose or free.
2 To forsake or abandon.
r. 10th cl. (मोचयति)
1 To let loose, to let go, to discharge as arrows, to part with, as wealth, &c.
2 To gladden, to delight.
(मोचते)
To deceive, to cheat.
(इ) मुचि r. 1st cl. (मुंचते)
1 To be vain or proud.
2 To be wicked.
3 To speak.
4 To grind or pound.
5 To cheat, to deceive.
With प्र,
To give much.
With वि,
1 To obtain liberation.
2 To give or bestow.
3 To lose.

m. (-कः)
Lac, the dye.
E.
मुच to loosen, aff. क्वुन्.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Munificent, generous, liberal in giving, a donor, a giver.
E.
मुच to let loose, to part with wealth, and किरच् Uṇādi aff.

f. (-टी)
1 Snapping the fingers.
2 The fist.
